title: Connect to AI
subtitle: Add this address to Claude or ChatGPT so the AI can log your workouts.

status.waitingHint: Say something to your assistant to test the connection, for example:

guideStep1: Open the Claude menu and choose Customize
guideStep3: Click the plus above the connector list
guideStep5: Type a name, for example Aim workout journal, paste your address and press Add
guideStep6: Open the connector you just added: under Tool permissions choose Always allow so Claude does not ask before every entry
guideStep7: In a chat press plus, open Connectors and switch your connector on
mobileNote: On your phone: open Settings → Connectors in the Claude app and add the connector there. The screens look a bit different, but the fields are the same as in steps 5 and 6.
guideNote: Screenshots are from the Claude web version.
guideStepChatgpt1: Open the profile menu (bottom left) and choose Settings
guideStepChatgpt2: Go to Security and login and turn on Developer mode
guideStepChatgpt3: In the left menu, open Plugins
guideStepChatgpt4: Click the plus button next to Search plugins
guideStepChatgpt5: Type a name, for example Aim, paste your address into Server URL, leave Authentication as No Auth, accept the risk notice and click Create
guideStepChatgpt6: Reload the page, then press plus next to the message box and make sure Aim is turned on
chatgptDevModeNote: ChatGPT calls this Developer mode and shows a red "elevated risk" warning — that's normal for any custom connector, not specific to AIm.
guideNoteChatgpt: Screenshots are from the ChatGPT web version.
warning: Don't share this link: it grants full access to your journal.
